Our 6kW 'Fronius' based installation was a replacement for an older, smaller system, and consisted of two 'strings' of panels, an inverter and a 'smart meter'. We initially looked into getting a battery system, but life intervened and found a better use for the extra dollars involved in this option. We still have the  option of adding the batteries later on with this system, though. I actually had a good idea about the system I wanted, and approached a couple of installers for their comments on my ideas and an indication of pricing, Both the sales-people I talked with were informative and courteous, and provided extra information to help me reach a decision.The team of installers arrived exactly on time, and got to work as soon as they had scoped the job. Our old system came off, the new system went on, with only a minor hiccup with getting larger cables through the small spaces within the walls. That was expertly resolved, and in a few hours the system was producing (and exporting) energy. There was a minor bug in the inverter connection to the remote web site, but that was fixed after consulting the manufacturer, (a software update?) and the inverter is now running at full throttle.The app to access the inverter's operation is pretty easy to use; I have it running full time on my office PC. The installer explained how to set it up and access the performance data on both a phone and a PC, and with a little digging thru the user accessible menus, I found the technical data reporting and graphing system, which is very comprehensive.All told, we are very happy with both the install and the solar energy system. The team got into the job, and just kept going until it was finished. They cleaned up the site when they had finished, were not unnecessarily noisy while they were working, and impressed me as being an efficient, competent team. The equipment certainly seems to be high quality, and to work quietly and without fuss or intervention. I would cheerfully recommend both the installers and the equipment to anyone who is considering replacing an old system or installing a new one.
